intended_object: The eigenvalue character of a normalized newform f restricted to the integral newspace Hecke algebra T_ℤ ⊂ End_ℂ(S_k^new(Γ₁(N))). This algebra is generated over ℤ by the good-prime Hecke operators T_p (p ∤ N) and the diamond operators. The character is the ℤ-algebra map T ↦ λ_f(T), where T f = λ_f(T) f. Inferred from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation:
The body composes two maps:
- the complex character `heckeTDiamondCuspNewCharacter f`, which sends an operator to its eigenvalue on the basis vector f (built with `eigenvalueHomOfJointEigenvector`), with scalars restricted to ℤ;
- the inclusion of the integral subalgebra into the complex newspace Hecke algebra.

The result is exactly the restriction of f's eigenvalue character to T_ℤ, which is how the literature defines it (Shimura, Ch. 3) and what the docstring says. The companion lemma confirms it sends T_p to f's eigenvalue a_p. Mathlib has no newform or Hecke algebra theory, so there is no counterpart there. The setting (Γ₁(N), level N, weight k) is the standard one, so the definition is not too narrow.
